title: 국가관광전략회의의 구성 및 운영에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
title_original: 국가관광전략회의의 구성 및 운영에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 4 (Members)
(1) In addition to the Chairperson, the Strategy Meeting shall consist of the Minister of Finance and Economy, the Minister of Education, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, the Minister of Justice, the Minister of the Interior and Safety, the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the Minister of Health and Welfare, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, the Minister of SMEs and Startups, the Minister of Planning and Budget, and the Minister for Government Policy Coordination. <Amended on November 5, 2019; October 1, 2025; December 30, 2025>
(2) Where the Chairperson deems it necessary in connection with any agenda item submitted to the Strategy Meeting, the Chairperson may invite the head of a relevant ministry or agency who is not a member to attend and speak at the meeting.
(3) Where the Chairperson deems it necessary, the Chairperson may, in consultation with the head of a ministry or agency related to an agenda item, invite a person who is not a member of the Strategy Meeting to attend and speak at the meeting.
